title: MSRF INC DOG DAD MUG AND COCOA IN GREEN PLAID  16OZ
descriptionText:
Enjoy your morning coffee or cocoa in style with this MSRF Inc Dog Dad Mug. The mug features a trendy green plaid pattern that is perfect for all occasions. It is made of high-quality ceramic and porcelain materials that ensure long-lasting durability. 

This 16oz mug is designed for a single serving and comes with a theme of "Dad" that makes it a great addition to any collection. Whether you are a dog lover or simply looking for a stylish mug, this MSRF Inc Dog Dad Mug is the perfect choice for you.
